profile.name: Karthick Raja G
profile.heroSummary: Results-driven DevOps and Full-Stack Developer building scalable serverless applications on AWS, designing RESTful APIs, and deploying containerized systems with precision.
bio: I'm a DevOps and Full-Stack Developer pursuing B.Tech in Information Technology at Adhiparasakthi College of Engineering, Ranipet (2022-2026), with a CGPA of 7.8.
Passionate about CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, and serverless architectures. I use AI-assisted tools like GitHub Copilot and Claude to ship faster and smarter.
I architect scalable solutions on AWS and build full-stack systems, from real-time employee monitoring to OTT streaming platforms with 50K+ monthly users.
profile.footer: 2026 - KARTHICK RAJA G - ALL SYSTEMS ONLINE

projects.title: Productivity Monitoring System
projects.description: Engineered a real-time employee productivity monitoring system achieving 95% accuracy using webcam-based face detection, emotion recognition, and behavior analytics. Built with React, Node.js, MySQL, Redis, Prisma, and Docker.

projects.title: OTT Video Streaming Platform
projects.description: Built a scalable OTT platform serving 50,000+ monthly active users. Achieved 99.9% uptime and reduced video load times by 30% through optimized RESTful APIs and JWT-based authentication.

projects.title: Learning Management System
projects.description: Full-stack LMS supporting course creation, enrollment, progress tracking, and admin dashboards with secure JWT authentication and optimized RESTful APIs.

projects.title: Serverless Web Application
projects.description: Deployed a highly scalable serverless web app using AWS S3, CloudFront, API Gateway, Lambda, and DynamoDB for persistent storage with CRUD operations.
